sentences.text: MittaTopi Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-28 under the industry code 71121, engineering design and technical consultancy.
First sales, a start-up notification and a board change are all dated 2026-07-28.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the record shows a consultancy and nothing about an ocean use.
